newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chung Hwa mulls spin-off listing in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Chung Hwa mulls spin-off listing in U.S..

text.p: Chung Hwa Development Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had filed a registration statement to propose a public offer of 1.25 million shares of its subsidary, Leading Edge Packaging Inc, with the Securities and Exchange Commission in the U.S.
The company would hold 60 percent of the issued shares capital of Leading Edge before exercise of option, it said.
If the option was fully exercised, the firm would hold approximately 56.6 percent of the issued share capital following the consummation of the public offer, it said.
Citicorp International Ltd and Yamaichi International (HK) Ltd have been appointed as the respective financial and co-financial adviser to the company, it said.
